international.title: Tusk appears to mock Trump’s Putin comment as Ukraine’s allies meet in Berlin – Europe live
international.summary: After US president called Putin a friend, Poland’s PM said: ‘God, protect us from such friends’ EU ministers are also getting some questions about tomorrow’s EU-UK summit, 10 years on from Britain’s vote to leave the bloc. Ireland’s EU minister Thomas Byrne said the main areas to be discussed on Friday “will have very significant benefits” for all parties, with the sanitary and phytosanitary agreement set to resolve “one of the biggest problems out of Brexit.” “I would encourage everyone to think seriously about the benefits of being in the EU, … and I think the people of the UK see it [too], now that they are outside the union.” Continue reading...
